Carbon Trust (2010). Industrial Energy Efficiency Accelerator: Guide to the industrial bakery sector. CTG034. London: The Carbon Trust. Prepared from technical work by SKM Enviros Ltd with the Food and Drink Federation. No publication date printed; PDF created October 2010; work done 2009-2010 (sector workshop 18 June 2010).

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page). Year 2010 verified from the text (work in 2009 and 2010) and the PDF creation date; code CTG034 on the cover. UK data. Main file: sector-average SEC (551 kWh/t fossil, 218 kWh/t electricity), derived combustion CO2 and average site output; monitored indirect (590 gas / 32 elec kWh/t, 15% efficiency) and direct (221 / 6 kWh/t, 32%) ovens; steam- and gas-heated provers (SEC printed 5.5 and 1.9 kWh/t; flagged, they look inconsistent with the stated 80-90 kW loads); per-plant retrofit costs (GBP per plant, no price year) for the Fig. 28 and Fig. 33 measures that have a capital cost, with 'project persistence 10 years' recorded as lifetime where printed. Measures file: all Fig. 28 and Fig. 33 rows (sector tCO2 saving, cost, payback, % sites) and the business-case summaries, with the percentage savings stated in the text. Other-values: sector statistics, loads, regressions, flue measurements and the oven/prover balances read from charts (Figs. 19-21 have no printed labels). Not extracted: charts without labels. UKERC's FD-B rows derive capex per t/yr from these per-plant costs divided by 2.5 Mt/89 sites (28,090 t), add +/-20-30% ranges, 5% O&M and 20-year lifetimes of their own.
